review_scope: Explicit experimental joint service source quality and portable lifecycle contracts; no model/performance acceptance
review_mode: Independent frozen-source review, CPU only; no Metal/weights/network

verification.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_joint_service.py tests/test_continuous_worker.py tests/test_continuous_backend.py tests/test_joint_budget.py tests/test_service.py
verification.ruff: passed for joint service/worker, continuous worker, app, CLI and joint tests

resolved_findings.description: Full joint round outputs exposed foreign concurrent request token IDs in API metadata. Independently reproduced; fixed with aggregate allowlists at session and worker boundaries and two-request result/event JSON regression.
Raw joint_experimental backend string bypassed explicit flag boundary. Rejected before lifespan; constructor regression passes.
Cancelled newcomer prefill triggered batch insertion failure and failed unrelated active requests. Backend-certified local cancellation now terminates only newcomer; isolation regression passes.
Inherited continuous tick budget/policy metrics did not describe joint execution. Removed from joint result; non-preemptible synchronous prefill documented.

reviewed_invariants: Distinct exact-identity pair configuration uses new files; audited target-only configurations remain unchanged
Cold combined target/draft weight and runtime guard executes before model loading; context and scratch reserve cover both models and padded verification
Only configured profile and greedy baseline requests accepted; effective joint mode is explicit and default baseline capability is not promoted
Both target and draft start with prompt minus pending tail; verifier commits emitted prefix and leaves last output pending
Only verified committed outputs reach multi-token event loop; terminal completion, cancellation between events, newcomer cancellation, slot generation and reservation release covered
No curve means full budget; current-source complete-cycle development curves require all legal q observations and exact pair/strategy/context identity
Public round fields contain aggregate allowlist only; no foreign output tokens or per-row observations
limits: CPU contract controls do not establish actual model service acceptance, serial equivalence, quality or speed advantage
Joint prefill is synchronous and non-preemptible; round cancellation is observed at verified-round boundary
No automatic cost calibration or trained confidence head; caller-supplied provenance cannot certify measurement truth
Source-bound approval applies only to listed hashes
